title: Analytic: hollow PEC waveguide TE10 through a dielectric section, mode ports (3D FDTD)
description:
A hollow rectangular metal waveguide along z (em_fdtd_3d, 20 nm cells) with a dielectric section eps = 2.25 of length L = 1 um; only half of the guide is modelled: the TE10 mode (E along y, sin(pi x / a)) is symmetric about the guide centre, where its tangential H vanishes, so bc_x_hi pmc (the grid edge) is that plane. Walls: two-cell pec_domain layers on x_lo, y_lo and y_hi (plus bc pec there), the surface at the centre of the inner wall layer, so a = 2 (L_x - 1.5 dx) = 0.98 um (pec and pmc lie half a cell apart) and b = L_y - 3 dx = 0.5 um; CPML (20 cells) on both z faces, the walls running into them. A mode_source (mode 1 = TE10, 1 W, gaussian at 1.43 um, bandwidth 0.1) at z = 0.31 um launches toward +z; mode_monitors at z = 0.5 um (incident: forward = incident power, backward = reflection) and z = 1.9 um (transmitted), 23 wavelengths 1.2-1.75 um. Needs scipy (cross-section mode solves at build).
Analytic (single-mode transmission line, TE wave impedance ~ 1 / beta): n1 = sqrt(1 - (lambda / 2a)^2) in the empty guide, n2 = sqrt(eps - (lambda / 2a)^2) in the section; T = 1 / (1 + F sin^2(2 pi n2 L / lambda)), F = ((n1^2 - n2^2) / (2 n1 n2))^2, R = 1 - T; the section fills the whole cross-section, so TE10 couples to no other mode. Peak T = 1 at 1.336 um (n2 L / lambda = 1), dip at 1.654 um (T = 0.532); T(1.35 um) = 0.997, T(1.65 um) = 0.535; n1(1.5 um) = 0.6437.
Curves & tables tab: T_mode = transmitted / incident forward mode power and R_mode = incident backward / forward, with the dotted references (independent of the launch spectrum).
Spectra / Curves: em.transmitted fraction_positive vs the dashed T (normalised by the nominal source power: the launch is exact at 1.43 um only, the dispersive TE10 impedance makes it (Z + Z0)^2 / (4 Z Z0) ~ 4 % high at 1.75 um, hence the looser tolerance).
Derived values tab: T_1350, T_1650, R_1650 from the ratio curves, n_eff_1500 = n_eff of the incident monitor vs n1.
Pulse spectrum: keep it off the TE10 cutoff. Spectrum at the cutoff (zero group velocity) stays near the source as a slowly decaying ringing (~t^-1/2), so the run-length DFT is truncated: a ripple with period ~lambda^2 / (c T_run) in the incident forward power. With bandwidth 0.4 the cutoff carried 0.66 of the peak amplitude and T / R were off by up to 0.08 at 1.6-1.75 um. The narrow pulse puts ~7e-4 there.
Expected agreement: ~0.3 % in T and R (Yee interface and dispersion, O((beta dx)^2)), ~2e-4 in n_eff (the 200 fs bandwidth 0.4 run: T_1350 6e-4, n_eff 1.3e-4; the ports touch pec / pmc faces, which the em3d mode ports treat approximately).
